data.name: Benedict
data.gender_notes: Benedict is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin benedicere, 'to bless' — 'blessed'. Its root is Latin benedicere. Saint Benedict of Nursia. Benedict is a Latin name meaning “Blessed”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Benedict expresses “Blessed”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Benedict total 35, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

data.cultural_impact: Benedict is used in Latin naming tradition with the meaning “Blessed”.
